events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The Iran war is escalating, with four possible scenarios for geopolitics after the war. The US has shown military strength, but also its waning geopolitical power. The conflict has revealed the UK's geopolitical standing and military readiness.
events.reasoning: The escalation of the Iran war will likely lead to increased defense spending and a boost to the aerospace and defense sector. On the other hand, the conflict may lead to a decrease in oil prices, negatively affecting the oil services sector.

timeFrame.note: Monitor the situation and adjust accordingly

events.exitStrategy: Exit when the conflict de-escalates or when the defense sector becomes overvalued

events.title: Federal Reserve Interest Rate Decision
events.summary: The Federal Reserve has held interest rates steady, but hints at a rate hike later this year. Fed Governor Michelle Bowman warns against hiking interest rates due to inflation spike.
events.reasoning: The Federal Reserve's decision to hold interest rates steady may lead to a boost in the stock market, while a potential rate hike later this year may lead to a rotation into shorter-term bonds.

timeFrame.note: Monitor the Fed's actions and adjust accordingly

events.exitStrategy: Exit when the Fed raises interest rates or when the stock market becomes overvalued

gains.conservativeNote: If the Fed keeps rates steady

events.title: NVIDIA AI Semiconductor Stocks
events.summary: NVIDIA has announced a multiyear technology partnership with SK hynix to advance memory for AI factories. NVIDIA's AI monopoly is slowly fading, but the company remains a leader in the AI chip market.
events.reasoning: NVIDIA's partnership with SK hynix and its continued leadership in the AI chip market may lead to a boost in the company's stock price. On the other hand, AMD's competition in the AI chip market may lead to a decrease in its stock price.

timeFrame.note: Monitor the AI chip market and adjust accordingly

events.exitStrategy: Exit when NVIDIA's AI monopoly is threatened or when the AI chip market becomes overvalued

gains.conservativeNote: If the AI chip market remains stable
gains.extendedNote: If NVIDIA's AI monopoly is strengthened
